newsitem.title: UK: NWE straight run fuel-high sulphur overhang clears.
newsitem.headline: NWE straight run fuel-high sulphur overhang clears.

text.p: The overhang of Russian high sulphur straight run has been clearing over the last couple of days and only a couple of cargoes now have homes to find.

An E-4 was sold at formula +$2.60 today, leaving only one still available this month. An M-100 also found a buyer at just below two means +$2 fob NWE. Another M-100 was heading to Dunkirk while a third was thought destined out of sector.
"The market has been thinned, and probably only one or two cargoes will end up in the barge market," said one trader.
Low sulphur has also been cleared and prices held around $126-128 fob NWE. -- Matthew Jones, London +44 171 542 8980
